id: \bThese are amazing, are they not? One of them could be a fossil.
en: \bThese are amazing, are they not? One of them could be a fossil.
it: \bSono fantastiche, non è vero? Una di queste potrebbe essere un fossile.

id: \bI wish the cave wasn't here. I hate going through it.
en: \bI wish the cave wasn't here. I hate going through it.
it: \bVorrei che questa grotta non ci fosse. Odio attraversarla.

id: \rCynthia: We'll break here and leave soon. Be sure to have your Pokémon fully healed before we go.
en: \rCynthia: We'll break here and leave soon. Be sure to have your Pokémon fully healed before we go.
it: \rCamilla: Facciamo una pausa qui e poi ripartiamo. Assicurati che i tuoi Pokémon siano in piena forma prima di andare.

id: \bBe careful kid. This place is dangerous.
en: \bBe careful kid. This place is dangerous.

id: \bI want to spice this place up. You think flowers would help?
en: \bI want to spice this place up. You think flowers would help?
it: \bVoglio ravvivare un po' questo posto. Pensi che dei fiori aiuterebbero?
"Il carbone e te: la miniera spiegata a tutti!"

id: \bGoh: I'm as ready as I will be.
en: \bGoh: I'm as ready as I will be.
it: \bGoh: Sono pronto, più di così non si può.

id: \bRoark is currently in the mines. I'm afraid you will have to come back later.
en: \bRoark is currently in the mines. I'm afraid you will have to come back later.
it: \bPedro al momento è nella miniera. Temo che dovrai tornare più tardi.
Capopalestra della Palestra Pokémon di Mineropoli:\nPedro

id: \rThis city has been mining for as long as I can remember. The city has become so big because of it.
en: \rThis city has been mining for as long as I can remember. The city has become so big because of it.
it: \rIn questa città si estrae da che io ricordi. È proprio grazie alla miniera che è diventata così grande.

id: \bThe museum is right next to me. It holds many fossils.
en: \bThe museum is right next to me. It holds many fossils.
it: \bIl museo è proprio qui accanto. Ospita tantissimi fossili.
